items.q: What does shading (tone) do in a drawing?
items.correct: Builds light and form by varying marks and pressure.
items.random_wrong: Is just colouring inside the lines.
items.why: Tone creates the illusion of three dimensions.

items.q: Can the primary colours be mixed from other colours?
items.correct: No — red, yellow and blue can't be mixed; they make secondaries.
items.misconception: Yes, you can mix primaries from other colours.
items.why: Primaries are starting points; mixing them makes secondaries.

items.q: Does observational drawing need heavy outlines on everything?
items.correct: No — form is often shown with tone and varied edges.
items.misconception: Yes, outline everything in dark line.
items.why: Artists suggest form through tone, line weight and edges.
